note: Web technology signatures for scanner/pipeline/fingerprint.py, matched against the one GET the stage already makes. Format and rules: scanner/pipeline/fingerprint_catalogue.py and docs/web-fingerprinting.md. Every entry needs a positive fixture in tests/fixtures/fingerprint/web_responses.json; cpe keys were checked against the NVD CPE dictionary on the date above and are left out where the product has no single key. The first six cdn_waf entries are the original #173 set and feed the risk model's compensating-control discount; keep their matchers as they are.
